card.name: And/or closing a list of items
card.fires_on: The word "and" (sometimes "or") right before the last item of a list of three or more. It is common in descriptive web text and also in label lists of effects.

modes.label: Lists in biographies and course text
modes.description: "and" before the final item in a list of activities, topics, people or works.
modes.example: including tennis, canoeing,<< and>> hiking in the Great Smoky Mountains.

modes.label: Lists of medical outcomes or procedures
modes.description: "and" or "or" before the last item in a list of clinical findings or treatments.
modes.example: increase in bilirubin levels, liver failure,<< and>> death
